notes.title: "Da Update" is available now for Aerial_Knight's Never Yield!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37851830/33267a5f5e2ba9b9ac727025df7f9666e82372d3.jpg

Hey friends!

Nothing but good news for you today: "Da Update" is now available on Steam! I was busy working on the update to optimize my game even more to bring you the ULTIMATE Aerial_Knight's Never Yield experience!

Let's celebrate this with a brand-new trailer - including a fresh tune right from the Aerial_Knight's Never Yield soundtrack:

[previewyoutube=rSYyhdw50T4;full][/previewyoutube]
"Da Update" adds a massive load of additional stuff and improvements:
 New Bonus Levels
 New Music
 Endless Mode
 Leaderboards
 UI Overhaul
 Graphical Updates
 New Achievements
 Level & Story Updates
 Various Bug Fixes
I hope you enjoy the update - and don't hesitate to share your feedback. I am really looking forward to hear your thoughts!

Till then and take care everyone!
Neil 'Aerial_Knight' Jones


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1323540

notes.title: "Da Update" adds new content and improvements to Never Yield in February!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37851830/6d5c032fbbfce74bdfb458e7f10ef714fcacacd0.jpg

Hey hey friends,

it's Neil aka Aerial_Knight! I have been very quiet for some time, but that had its reasons. I was busy working on Never Yield to optimize my game even more to bring you the ULTIMATE Aerial_Knight's Never Yield experience!

That's why I'm really happy to announce "Da Update" to you! As the name implies, I will release a major update for Never Yield, which will add a massive load of new stuff and improvements:

 New Bonus Levels
 New Music
 Endless Mode
 Leaderboards
 UI Overhall
 Graphical Updates
 New Achievements
 Level & Story Updates
 Various Bug Fixes
The release is planed for February - so you don't have to wait much longer for the update. So grab your running shoes and get ready!

Oh, and the update will be released completely free of charge, of course! 👍🏿

Till then and take care everyone!
Neil 'Aerial_Knight' Jones


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1323540/Aerial_Knights_Never_Yield/
